name: Monero Punks
about: The 1,019 Monero Punks of moneropunks.com, editions 0 to 1018, as the creator's gallery listed them in March 2023: each edition with the Mordinal it was registered as and the Keccak-256 of its artwork (the gallery's ordinal_hash). Anyone could pick a Punk on the site and register it, so the registrations carry many different titles and descriptions; the gallery is what ties them together. registrationTx is the transaction this index counts for that Mordinal. id is the group the metadata rule made from the description most of them share, so links to it keep working.
replacesNote: b3af858037258e8cac8b5706 is the group of inscriptions titled "Monero Punks #n". One of them (Mordinal 1124) is a creator edition; the other 32 are 200 x 200 copies outside the creator's catalogue and are left ungrouped, so that only the creator's editions carry the name.
